meta.title: Appearances
meta.description: Where Novitatis shows up: keynotes, panels, podcasts and exhibitions on AI and digital tourism, plus what we speak about and how to book a talk.

heroTitle: Talks built on our own research.
heroLead: Novitatis is a research-led voice on AI and the digital future of tourism. We speak in Hungarian and English, from conference keynotes to closed-door workshops with destination teams, and the talks now travel internationally. Every one is built on our own primary data, the same work that runs through our consulting, our peer-reviewed publishing and an active PhD on the team.

cta.heading: Planning an event or a team session?
cta.body: Tell us the audience and the date, and we will propose a talk.
